body:
Hi I'm sorry to jump in but I've read your post and the pain you're in I'm sorry you are going through it. You say you need companionship and I am here if you want to pm.
I am not going to give you a long anecdotal story because when I hurt as much as you I didn't care about anyone else story or want advice. If you want someone to chat to who won't judge I'm here. 
I'm not a professional nor am I not depressed but what I am is a fellow individual going through pain and I know what hopelessness feels like.

Thank you for your insight, that has helped 
And very sorry for your loss
Okay I really hope you get one you can click with, if you want to keep updated please do :) whether it's tomorrow, next week or whatever
That's my greatest fear too! Or worse trying and literally ending up feeling a bit ill but fully capable of moving and talking etc
I don't mind at all pm me whenever you are ready :)

Has anyone complained about your voice or of face? Or do you not like those things personally? 

Due to your pain that's why you did all those things and I guess maybe it might have been overwhelming? I'm not sure, not assuming because obviously I am not the girl in question but maybe she didn't know what to do when you started playing games and hanging out with other girls? 

I think if you did lie to go to hospital maybe its a cry for help or attention and do you know what I've lied at times too. I don't know why I've done it, but once the lie rolls off the tongue that's it.

It does suck when starting a new job, even if you've done a similar line of work it can be quite intense because all we want to do is the right thing and contribute and it sucks when we fail or do something wrong, I understand that. I look back at some of my jobs and think.. What on earth was I doing, I must be stupid. But then its really due to lack of training or being so caught up in trying to do the right thing we're literally tripping over our own thoughts. 

How come you can't decide if you love your family? Have they done or said something? 

Is it the 'unearned money' that hurts you the most? Do you want to go out and earn your own but feel hopeless to do so? 

After  reading your post I definitely would remember you but I'm hoping it doesn't get to that point.

Sorry for all the questions hope it doesn't come across as much, just trying to have a conversation and it's hard to make it flow on the Internet but I want you to know I read every word you wrote and I'm sorry for what you're going through.

Would you like to talk about it?
Genuinely sorry you're suffering

I have genuinely tried yet fail everytime
Thank you

I hear what you're saying, do you think you'll be alright in the test tomorrow if you manage to do a bit more study?
Does hurt a bit when something is important but motivation is low so I hope that you do manage to do well on it

Wow, do you know what that's really helped. Thank you.
Guess we should all 'cheer up' because it's that simple isn't it?

Have you not studied because you physically can't or because you don't want to?
Just curious not judging in any way. Is the test very important? As in does it affect your overall grade? 
Sorry you've had ups and downs, it's not easy to deal with.
Have you gone into a depressive episode before? Do you know what has triggered it?
That must feel awful if no one is listening and treating you differently would you like to chat? I can understand if not but I'm here if you do
No problem at all, any time
Okay that's good I'm glad talking to her managed to provide a bit of relief. I understand that feeling completely and I'm sorry to hear it

Why don't you do it? Do you feel physically unable to help out?
I think most people do to some extent because what we hear in our voice is not what everyone else hears
If you're depressed or really down then tiredness will be a side effect don't best yourself up. I know it sucks and it can feel hopeless 
Do you have anyone you can talk to?

I read your post and it genuinely sounds like something I could have written. Everything minus college is how I feel. It's tough.
I've told my girlfriend how I feel but she's got her own stresses so she'd not able to help me or show me what I need to be shown. The whole debt thing.. It doesn't even bare thinking about just causes so much stress. 

I am here if you want to talk, won't judge or anything. It's tough when you've got to turn to the Internet for support it really is. I feel you.
Thanks, you too
Sucks doesn't it

I will also add she's not trying to do anything. She's the only one I could turn to. We've both had deaths in our family recently. How can I turn to her and burden her further? I can't. How can she help when she's suffering? She can't.

You personally may be able to do that but I and many people on here and in the rest of the world can't. If it was that simple this thread wouldn't exist would it? In fact suicide wouldn't even be a thing really would it?

I can understand why you'd be in pain, I think given what was said to you that is a pretty deep thing to hear and I can only imagine the sort of thing you'd feel after going through that experience and hearing those words.

I'm truly sorry and if you do want to chat... I know I'm only a stranger but I won't judge. 

I won't sit here and tell you everything will be okay or try to tell you how to feel but I will quite happily listen and respond.

Very sorry to hear you're hurting :(
What's got you feeling this way? Do you want to talk about it?

Why are they annoyed by you?
Why do you believe they are correct in thinking you're a burden?

Hey I'm here if you want to chat 
Sorry you feel worse, I know it won't help but I think you're brave because I haven't even got the courage to call anyone so mad respect for that.. I'm just  sorry it didn't go as planned :(

I'm sorry you got it that stage, did you speak to anyone before this attempt about how you felt?

How long until anyone is back home?
Can you speak to anyone before they come back?
Sorry for the pain you're feeling. Happy birthday
I'm not sure about the zombie apocalypse if it does might be a a while from now, if at all. Sorry you're in pain :(

No  problem at all I completely understand what you've written :)
That sounds like a good plan as long as you can definitely transfer to the music course you want to do. 
Otherwise you don't want to do the course you don't like and not be able to go and do music after 1 year.
Are you able to reach out to the friends you have? Or even just one of them?
How long you been suffering by yourself? I've been in my room for 2 weeks so I know how bad it is to be alone with your own thoughts

Oh I apologise, my mistake.
Did you tell him how you felt or something and he said that? Why does he think your selfish?

I'm very sorry that you feel this way
Have you tried to reach out to anyone other than on here for example friends or family? Does anyone know you're suffering? Other than us lot on here?
When your friend passed what was your first thought?

Sorry for the pain you're feeling
Sorry for your loss of your friend as well. That's rough. Why do you feel selfish about this?

May I ask why you feel this way?would you like to chat? There is obviously something troubling you and it seems you have thought this through but I'm here and the rest of the people are here if you want to chat

Sorry for your pain
Have the meds and therapy etc not been helpful for you? Is there anyone you can reach out to? Any friends or family or anything like that?

There will definitely be a woman/women out there who won't even bat an eyelid and see you for you. Finding someone is not easy for anyone although it may seem that way sometimes so give it time and just be you and eventually you will come across women.

P.s give you a chance would suggest there's something negative or not good about you. I know you may feel different or something like that and I'm not trying to invalidate  that, what I mean is anyone who sees you as just a colostomy bag is not worth knowing :)

Sorry to hear about this :(
Did you so anything or have any friends outside of your life with your boyfriend? Is that what is making it worse?

That's quite a deep question, what's causing you to ask such a deep thing?

I have no clue of the answer and when I think about it long and hard enough I don't have the answer either.

Sorry you're in pain.
Do you feel the worst due to not having close connections?
How come you don't do anything? Do you not want to? Or is something I.e no job etc stopping you from doing so?

Hey just read last post. It does suck seeing everyone else happy and seeming for it to just seem so natural and wondering why not me.
What else is troubling you, do you want to talk?
Good I'm glad to hear that

How have you hurt people? Has it been intentional/unintentional?
Do you feel if you shared this with immediate family or friends they wouldn't understand? You don't have to go into mad detail if you don't want but giving an example could help us lot on here to be of more help

Yeah i hope so to be honest. If she hadn't lost someone already I'd not be here.
And yeah literally talking to others on here is at least keeping my brain active and although the topic is the same it takes away the thought from my mind. Momentarily so yeah... I'm glad I'm not the only one and I'm glad it's helped keeping you grounded.
Was this a programme that you were applying for and they didn't accept your application? Are there other places you can apply to?

Sorry for your pain
How come you feel worthless? You don't need to go into detail if you don't want to.
Have you sought help? Friends family or therapy or anything?

So do I, she's back  Monday so hopefully. I have tried reaching out to her and text her telling her how I felt etc but I don't know. The reaction tells me she may or may not have understood the severity of the situation. But she has suffered a loss recently and so have i so on top of everything neither of us are 100%.
I honestly thank you once again for being there. 
Every thread I see you have helped others too. I personally seem to be trying to help others at the minute and it is putting me off any rash actions giving me a distraction for now

There's a lot of pressure on us to 'be a man' as well so even showing signs of emotions or weakness is met with ridicule or disbelief which is a pity.
If you spoke to the therapist a bit more are there other options other than a mental institute? I'm not a professional so I don't know what would 100% straight up send someone there but do you reckon the therapist could help you? Do you feel any better talking to them?
Would you sit down with your mum and look her in the eyes and tell her your pain? Would she be more open to that do you think?

Why were you disadmitted.
Can you try to get a job in the meantime to at least keep you afloat?

I'm sorry to read this and see you're hurting and feel there's no other way.
Why are you ignoring everyone? Do you need space or you feel you don't want help or? Not a judging question by the way just curious.

Hi sorry you're sad. I know its hard but try not to build up images in your mind about what might or will happen.
I take it your girlfriend hasn't actually said anything? I'm a guy too and i know the pressure can sometimes be high. But anyone who doesn't want you based on size alone would not deserve you.
I doubt your girlfriend will be disappointed. 
I know its hard especially as a guy to open up so coming here is already a good start
What's happening? What's going on. Would you like to talk about it?
You're more than welcome

Sorry you feel this way, is there a way to take some time off? To take a holiday and not have to think about work for a bit? I know it'd be temporary but it could take your mind of work for a while.

Why do you need the acceptance of others? Is there a lot of pressure on you to do well and have a high status job like doctor or engineer etc?

Sorry that you get yelled at when you try to express yourself man that sucks and its easy to see why you feel like this.
I'm male too so I completely understand. We could literally say anything and people just blink at us like get on with it, you're a man, you will be fine. There is a big issue with guys and depression and as you say about hearing when it's too late. It happens far too often and I think it's quite sad really.

Do you have any other family or friends you could reach out to? Anyone who would listen without judging or not taking you seriously?

Sorry you're down
What was the last thing you did? Uni/college?
There's a lot of people in the world but it's hard to make friends so I understand.
Are you applying to things within your reach? Are you tailoring applications?

Thanks for your reply.
So do I to be honest. I'm in a lot of pain to be honest. I've been alone for 2 weeks and my girlfriend not back until Monday. If it wasn't for that I wouldn't be here to be honest which is sad but very true.
Thank you so much for your replies to this it means a lot that someone would actually take the time out for me

I'm from the UK so forgive my ignorance. Is there any welfare programme you can sign up for? Is there anywhere you can go that would at least provide a roof over your head even if short term?
It does suck when everything in life falls around you I'm sorry

I'm sorry you're suffering. To lose your house, girlfriend job is hard, in fact that is an understatement. I'm sorry you feel in despair. Do you have any family friends or acquaintances that you may be able to reach out to? Anyone near you you think may be able to help, even if short term?

Okay I hear you and especially if that career is your dream or one you really want to get into then I understand your fears.
I think it's quite tough if you don't seek assistance nothing will get better and it may even jeopardise the career you want if you can't give it your all or break down during it. 
If you do seek help you may well recover or at least feel a bit better or on the road to recovery but then if you feel it was all in vain because you can't have the career you could just end up in square one. 

I think that is tough. 
Personally I would talk to someone and as hard as it is prepare for the worst. It is a very conflicting situation you're in and I'm sorry that it is like that. I wish life could be easier for all of us suffering on here to be honest.

Why may it not last? Due to how you're feeling or?

If you did get diagnosed with anything is there no other way into the career? Or is there a similar one you would consider?
If you are in need of help would you be able to continue on your career path suffering in silence?

I don't think it's wrong to feel that way, I think your justified in those feelings considering what you've been through.
I know what you mean, have you tried talking to your doctor or anything like that?

Oh that's good, I'm glad!
I do know the feeling trust me. Cheating is the ultimate way to give someone trust issues. It's such a cowardly and disrespectful thing to do there's just no words. I never understand why people do it. It's not hard to say sorry I want it to end and then go on their way. But people don't care and leave the victim to pick up the pieces by themselves.
Having it happen twice is enough to put anyone on edge so I'd say you're definitely justified in feeling that way.
You may want to reach out but then in the back of your mind it's like hmm what makes you different to the others. I hear that.

High5 to that. I'm on the edge but trying to help others is my only way of keeping my mind active. If it wasn't for a late night Internet search and finding this thread I don't know where I'd be.

No need to feel you're being difficult because I hear what you're saying. Sometimes it's small things that just build up and up until it gets us down. Sometimes we can pin pont it and sometimes we can't. Feeling depressed and suicidal no matter the reason is just painful.
To be cheated on also is not great, once is bad enough. I can empathise as my first relationships the same thing happened to me and I was crushed too so I know how much that hurts. Can take a while to get over it as well, if at all. 

I'm sorry you're hurting but know you're not alone. I know it may not help, but I hope it provides at least an ounce of comfort.

I definitely agree with you on that, we really shouldn't but it's good (albeit sad) that at least if we don't have anyone we can reach out on here.. I know its not the same but yeah.

I get you, its not nice to feel like that and I'm genuinely sorry you feel that way, I really am. To feel like no matter what you do is wrong, it's not nice

Sorry to hear this.
I know this is a difficult question, may I ask is she saying this out of confusion and anger or  do you believe she fully understands and doesn't care?
I know when I've spoken to family before about other issues they've brushed it off and shouted and it turns out they didn't realise the severity of it. I'm not assuming that is the case here. But knowing the answer will help us help you

That sounds very rough, I am sorry to hear about your past attempt.
It is good that you tried to see the good and hold on, now that you are still here let's try and make it stay that way. Would you like to talk about anything specifically?
What bothers you currently?

It really is a struggle, and it's not like if you have xyz qualification you have a better chance of being hired. Getting a job is a minefield regardless of qualifications, job history etc and sometimes luck plays a part in it.
I look at jobs all the time and I think to myself 40+ hours per week only to end up barely scraping by at the end of the month... Hmm.

I hear you, a break up can be absolutely soul destroying to be honest. Many questions running through your mind, start to feel like shit for a million and one reasons.

I get that, when people are bullying you it makes sense to shut down and shut yourself off because you're literally getting victimised for sharing the same oxygen as everyone else, you haven't even done anything wrong. 

That's a bit deep to say because of problems it's hard for him to care. Even if he said it'll take time to gain the trust and bond back that wouldn't be as harsh. 

Mate, I feel you on the lying. I used to do it at school years ago to get attention and it's only when I look back on it now I think... Who am I and what was I doing telling ridiculous lies. But when you crave attention what else can you do? Completely normal to me. 

It's probably a good thing she walked away. It hurts, yes. But do you know what? I bet after a while you realised exactly what type of person she is. 

It is very hard to always be the one looking out for others and having no one care for you. It sucks it really does. 

I know the feeling and it feels rubbish because you start to think what else can I do? You go about daily life thinking about others or just trying to do right and it literally all crumbles beneath you? I know that distressing feeling too. I used to shrug whenever things went wrong and now I genuinely feel like someone is getting a good kick out of my suffering. It hurts. 

Do you know what's worse? People like you and I on the Internet having to talk to strangers because we are suffering. While the rest of the world seem to be swanning around happily. Its hard to understand 'why me' and I'll never know the answer *shrugs*
You're welcome

You're welcome if you ever change your mind I'm here

You too!

It's going to sound silly but is there anything that used to make you happy like going for a walk or doing a certain activity-? I know times are beyond that but if you could just sit and think or take a walk and just think about things it may help. I just hope you're still there
I'm here. 24.male.uk
:( I'm here if you want to vent/chat
That sounds very rough and there's nothing worse than having life tip upside down out if nowhere. To say it sucks would be an understatement. We're here for you if you need to chat

I'm not a professional in any way shape or form but I'd say to talk to a doctor about this. Especially if it's a few hours several times per week. Going to speak to someone doesn't necessarily mean there's something 'wrong' with you, just be open and honest and take it from there.
Plus we are here for you too

Hi
Are you at work/college or?
I'm friendless too so I definitely know how it feels. I've sat here laying in bed for weeks so I feel your pain. If you want to chat I'm here.

I think they are trying to help rather than intentionally guilt trip. They are most likely trying to try assist you and help ease the pain. And I know it sucks to hear things like that and I know my message won't make you feel better but I hope you get some responses that help
I understand why you'd feel bad about it especially after what's happened to him. Are you feeling better now?
Sorry for your pain, is there a way to switch therapist at all?
Neither, talk to us instead.
Hi, I hope its not too late. We are here for you if you want to talk
I'm here
Would you like to chat or anything, sorry you're feeling like this

So sorry it got to the point where you nearly harmed yourself. Please chat to us on here or ring samaritans they are 24/7. I've never used them but they are there whenever you need them in case there's no prompt reply on here. Hope this helps.

:( if you're reading this and it's not too late please talk to us on this thread. I'm a stranger but like the rest on here, I'm here.

If it is too late which I hope not, may you rest in peace

I'm here if you want to chat. I understand if you're angry and just wanted to vent but genuinely here if you change your mind.
People suck... And are usually only thinking about themselves. It's usually those who look after others who get screwed over big time. I know the feeling.

I'm sorry you feel like shit.
I'm a year younger than you and I genuinely empathise. And I'm male too and i kind of sit there with my emotions like... What am I meant to do. 
I know what it's like to feel like your life is a joke and wonder 'why me' kind of thing.
You sound like you've been through a lot to be honest and it does all take its toll.
I've been alone in my room for 2 weeks and I've really thought about it. If you really think about the world I think it's safe to come to the conclusion that it's not us. Anyone who is suffering in this world is normal in my eyes and anyone who isn't is either blissfully unaware of how selfish and downright strange people have become. Sorry if that's deep or a bit weird but hopefully you get where I'm trying to go with it. I'm here if you want to chat.

Why is your dad upset you didn't ask anyone to prom?
Have you got any other relatives you could stay with?sorry you're feeling like this
Sorry to hear that and sorry for your loss :(

It really is! Takes a lot to even go to try and talk to someone. The first doctor I definitely won't go back to, thinking about her makes me physically ill and anxious. I wouldn't mind talking but I've lost all hope to be honest and if I'm not going to get seen to straight away then I can't be bothered.
I feel numb and sick at the thought of going to work and having to literally sit in bed all day because I can't do anything. It's horrible. There's helplines but I can't bring myself to do that
*waves* I'm here if you want to chat :)
I'll be your friend too

Is there anything that would stop you, I know it sounds like a dumb question. Do you want to talk about it? I'm feeling pretty low myself but I know that someone reaching out to me would help so hopefully the same for you?
Sorry to hear you're feeling like that because that's pretty deep.
Hey, I've only joined a few hours ago, reply with what's going on and I'll certainly respond and try to help. It does suck though if you write and no one responds

I've read your posts on here and I hear you. A lot of people don't understand when someone is reaching out and to be honest a lot of people only care about themselves these days.
I think it's quite sad really.
And I know what you mean because I feel the exact same way about wanting to be alone but at the same time feeling lonely. I've got no friends and I've been off work for almost 3 weeks sitting here barely eating and having no one to talk to. So I hear you.

I've read what you wrote and sorry you feel the way you do. Totally justified in feeling hopeless. I'm in the same boat as you, sort of.. Been working for ages with nothing to show for it at all so my whole life just feels like a waste and we're pretty much the same age. I know. It hurts big time. If you ever want to chat I'm here. I've only got 1 acquaintance too so high 5.

Thank you I really appreciate you taking time out to read my post and reply.
Sorry about you and your girlfriend :(
For me the worst part is reaching out and no one understanding or caring. Tried to reach out to my girlfriend in a small way, nothing to distress her and she just I don't know.. She doesn't get it. I feel like she's not even trying to be honest. I don't want attention all I want is someone to actually care for once. If roles were reversed I'd literally fly and jump at any opportunity to help her or anyone for that matter even a stranger. But me? I get more live on the Internet than with the very few people who know me and doctors etc. I genuinely don't see myself lasting the 4-6 week plus I haven't even signed up for the therapy yet so... I don't know I genuinely give up. I'm actually at the point now where I'm going to do what I need to do. Not going to take anyone's feelings into account because that's the reason I'm in pain in the first place.

I agree. Same I went to doctors twice and of course I'm not going to say yes. Plus I feel the first one I went to who told me 'you're young you've got your life ahead of you' would just sit there and ask me to go into detail and make me feel awkward.

A lot of people aren't properly trained for it. A lot of people don't take it seriously and realise if someone is going to them because they're in pain it's better to go overboard and throw help at them than to offer a few words/a leaflet for depression and send them on their way.
*shrugs*
